data.one_liner: A simple timer that can be scheduled for a specific time and persists across app restarts.
data.what_it_does: It lets you schedule a callback to run at a given DateTime instead of after a delay. The scheduled time is saved with SharedPreferences and restored after the app restarts. If the time is missed, an optional callback can handle it.
use_when: You need a lightweight, in‑app timer that survives restarts without background services
You want to avoid platform‑specific alarm APIs and keep everything in Dart
avoid_when: The app may be terminated or in the background and you need the timer to fire anyway
You require high‑precision or OS‑level scheduling
weaknesses: Runs only while the app is active
Cannot wake the device or execute in background
